name: Atlantis (STS-76)
about: Atlantis (STS-76) (1996-018A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1996 Mar 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1996 Mar 24), held fixed
docked to A05709; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
